info.title: Variety Groceries production API
info.description: Implemented production subset: identity, catalogue, Product Media upload/review plus queued image-generation authority, inventory receiving, delivery configuration, authoritative checkout/orders, provider-neutral Payments Authority, provider-neutral Refunds Authority, Fulfilment + Stock Handover Authority, and Dispatch + Rider Authority. COD cash collection/remittance, physical returns/restocking, POS cash authority, live courier providers, GPS/ETA/route optimization, notifications and complete public storefront cutover remain closed.
